import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment

def test_macro_native_output(native_env):
    template = native_env.from_string("{%- macro x() -%}{{- [5,6] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0] -}}")
    result = template.render()
    assert result == 5
